identity_evidence: Executive Order 603 (1907), signed March 29, 1907, private secretary to Commissioner of the General Land Office

identity_evidence: Dated December 1, 1913; Mr. Richard Cullen, War Department, reinstatement and transfer (no order number in the text)
basis: The order appears to allow transfer of one named person (Richard Cullen), but the text is incomplete: it opens with the tail of a different order, has no signature, and breaks off mid-sentence, so every clause of the order cannot be checked. Failing under the strictness rule.
operative_quote:
Mr. Richard Cullen may be transferred, after reinstatement in the War Department,
without reference to the requirement in clause (a), section 8 of civil-service rule X
notes: Text begins with the end of a preceding order (waiver in a case where the Commission did not concur) and ends mid-sentence at 'He was separated from a'; reinstatement command itself is not visible; order number 1863 not in text. Cullen was a Civil War veteran, so the person-died rationale would apply if the text were complete.
